items.text: Nampa abantu belizwe ababuya ekuthunjweni kulabo ababethunjiwe nguNebukadineza inkosi yaseBabiloni, yabasa eBabiloni ababuyela eJerusalema lakoJuda, kwaba yilowo lalowo emzini wakibo.
Bafika bekhokhelwa nguZerubabeli loJeshuwa loNehemiya loSeraya loRehelaya loMoridekayi loBilishani loMisipari loBigivayi loRehuma loBahana.
Nantu uluhlu lwabantu bakoIsrayeli. AbakoParoshi, babezinkulungwane ezimbili lekhulu lamatshumi ayisikhombisa lambili;
abakoShefathiya babengamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi ayisikhombisa lambili;
abakoAra babengamakhulu ayisikhombisa lamatshumi ayisikhombisa lanhlanu;
abakoPahathi‐Mowabi, ngitsho abendlu kaJeshuwa loJowabi, babezinkulungwane ezimbili lamakhulu aficaminwembili letshumi lambili;
abakoElamu babeyinkulungwane lamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amahlanu lane;
abakoZathu babengamakhulu aficamunwemunye lamatshumi amane lanhlanu;
abakoZakayi babengamakhulu ayisikhombisa lamatshumi ayisithupha;
abakoBani babengamakhulu ayisithupha lamatshumi amane lambili;
abakoBebayi babengamakhulu ayisithupha lamatshumi amabili lantathu;
abakoAzigadi babeyinkulungwane lamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amabili lambili;
abakoAdonikamu babengamakhulu ayisithupha lamatshumi ayisithupha lesithupha;
abakoBigivayi babezinkulungwane ezimbili lamatshumi amahlanu lesithupha;
abakoAdini babengamakhulu amane lamatshumi amahlanu lane;
abakoAteri, ngitsho bakoHezekiya, babengamatshumi aficamunwemunye lesificaminwembili;
abakoBezayi babengamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi amabili lantathu;
abakoJora babelikhulu letshumi lambili;
abakoHashuma babengamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amabili lantathu;
abakoGibari babengamatshumi aficamunwemunye lanhlanu;
amadoda aseBetlehema ayelikhulu lamatshumi amabili lantathu;
amadoda aseNetofa ayengamatshumi amahlanu lesithupha;
amadoda aseAnathothi ayelikhulu lamatshumi amabili lesificaminwembili;
amadoda aseAzimavethi ayengamatshumi amane lambili;
amadoda aseKiriyatharimi laseKefira laseBerothi ayengamakhulu ayisikhombisa lamatshumi amane lantathu;
amadoda aseRama laseGeba ayengamakhulu ayisithupha lamatshumi amabili lanye;
amadoda aseMikimasi ayelikhulu lamatshumi amabili lambili;
amadoda aseBetheli laseAyi ayengamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amabili lantathu;
amadoda aseNebo ayengamatshumi amahlanu lambili;
abakoMagibishi babelikhulu lamatshumi amahlanu lesithupha;
abakoElamu omunye babeyinkulungwane lamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amahlanu lane;
abakoHarimi babengamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi amabili;
abakoLodi labakoHadidi labakoOno babengamakhulu ayisikhombisa lamatshumi amabili lanhlanu;
abakoJeriko babengamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi amane lanhlanu;
abakoSenaha babezinkulungwane ezintathu lamakhulu ayisithupha lamatshumi amathathu.
Nantu uluhlu lwabapristi. AbakoJedaya bendlu kaJeshuwa, babengamakhulu aficamunwemunye lamatshumi ayisikhombisa lantathu;
abakolmeri babeyinkulungwane lamatshumi amahlanu lambili;
abakoPashuri babeyinkulungwane lamatshumi amane lesikhombisa;
abakoHarimi babeyinkulungwane letshumi lesikhombisa.
Nantu uluhlu lwamaLevi. AbakoJeshuwa labakoKadimiyeli, usendo lukaHodaviya, babengamatshumi ayisikhombisa lane.
Nantu uluhlu lwabahlabeleli. AbakoAsafi babelikhulu lamatshumi amabili lesificaminwembili.
Nantu uluhlu lwabalindi bamasango. AbakoShaluma labakoAteri labakoTalimoni labakoAkubi labakoHatita labakoShobayi, bonke babelikhulu lamatshumi amathathu lesificamunwemunye.
Nantu uluhlu lwezinceku zasethempelini. AbakoZiha labakoHasufa labakoTabhawothi
labakoKerosi labakoSiyaha labakoPadoni
labakoLebana labakoHagaba labakoAkubi
labakoHagabi labakoShamilayi labakoHanani
labakoGideli labakoGahari labakoReyaya
labakoRezini labakoNekoda labakoGazama
labakoUza labakoPaseya labakoBesayi
labakoAsina labakoMewunimi labakoNefisimi
labakoBakibuki labakoHakufa labakoHarihuri
labakoBaziluthi labakoMehida labakoHarisha
labakoBarkosi labakoSisera labakoTema
labakoNeziya labakoHatifa.
Nantu uluhlu lwenzalo yezinceku zikaSolomoni. AbakoSotayi labakoHasoferethi labakoPeruda
labakoJahala labakoDarkoni labakoGideli
labakoShefathiya labakoHathili labakoPokerethi‐Hazebayimi labakoAmi.
Zonke inceku zasethempelini lenzalo yezinceku zikaSolomoni babengamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi aficamunwemunye lambili.
Nampa abavela eTeli‐Mela laseTeli‐Harisha laseKerubi laseAdani laseImeri ababengelakutsho izindlu zaboyise, lokuba badabuka koIsrayeli yini;
abakoDelaya labakoTobiya labakoNekoda babengamakhulu ayisithupha lamatshumi amahlanu lambili.
Phakathi kwabapristi kwakungabakoHobaya labakoHakozi labakoBarizilayi, owayethethe enye yamadodakazi kaBarizilayi waseGileyadi, wasebizwa ngebizo lawo.
Badinga amabizo abo oluhlwini lwabalotshiweyo ngezizukulwana, kodwa bawaswela; basebekhutshwa ebupristini, kwathiwa kabafanelanga.
Umbusi wabatshela ukuba bangadli ukudla okungcwele, kuze kube khona umpristi wokubuza inkatho iUrimi leThumimi.
Nani 27:21
Lonke ibandla selihlangene lalingabantu abazinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amane lambili lamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi ayisithupha,
ngaphandle kwenceku lencekukazi zabo ezazizinkulungwane eziyisikhombisa lamakhulu amathathu lamatshumi amathathu lesikhombisa; babelabahlabeleli abesilisa labesifazana abangamakhulu amabili.
Amabhiza abo ayengamakhulu ayisikhombisa lamatshumi amathathu lesithupha, lembongolo zabo zingamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amane lanhlanu;
amakamela abo engamakhulu amane lamatshumi amathathu lanhlanu, labobabhemi babo bezinkulungwane eziyisithupha lamakhulu ayisikhombisa lamatshumi amabili.
Ekufikeni kwabo endlini yeNkosi eJerusalema ezinye inhloko zezindlu zanikela ngesihle ukuba indlu yeNkosi yakhiwe endaweni yayo.
Zanikela esikhwameni somsebenzi ngamandla azo inhlamvu zegolide ezizinkulungwane ezingamatshumi ayisithupha lanye,
esiliva azinkulungwane ezingamakhulu amabili lamatshumi amahlanu, lezambatho zabapristi ezilikhulu.

Abapristi lamaLevi kanye labanye abantu bahlala eJerusalema lendaweni eziseduze lalo; abahlabeleli labalindi bamasango lezinceku zasethempelini kanye labo bonke abanye abakoIsrayeli bahlala emizini yabo.
1 Lan 9:2
Neh 11:3
